channels.note: LDH's beach monitoring page (https://ldh.la.gov/page/beach-monitoring-program) lists its 23 coastal monitoring sites with the most recent sample date and advisory status; advisories are issued weekly every Thursday from May 1 to October 31. The page links LDH's map, whose layer BEACH_ADVISORY_STATUS (https://services5.arcgis.com/O5K6bb5dZVZcTo5M/arcgis/rest/services/BEACH_ADVISORY_STATUS/FeatureServer/0) is open: one row per site with STATUS, ADVISORY_REASON, SAMPLE_DATE, TIME_SAMPL, ENTEROCOCCI, GEO_MEAN and a point (23 rows on 2026-11-21, 1 ADVISORY: Lake Charles North Beach, sampled 2026-10-20, the same as the page). The page answers 403 to this project's named client (this Mac and GitHub's runner, run 44913220623, 2026-11-21) and 200 to a browser's user agent (this Mac, 2026-11-21), which decision 30 allows; the layer answers the named client on both, so the row watches the layer. Not collected yet: the generic ArcGIS reader can read the layer with a fetch block only (a STATUS filter and history.confirm_while_listed), no new code. The earlier bot-wall barrier rested on the named client's 403 alone.
